To cater to the talented and skilled human resource needed for the global technological and socio-economic advancement MADHYANCHAL PROFESSIONAL UNIVERSITY (MPU) was established in 2018 under the aegis of Vanshpati Smriti Shiksha Samiti (VSSS), Bhopal. Since 2002, the Samiti has been promoting a group of 8 colleges at Bhopal and Indore under the banner of PATEL GROUP OF INSTITUTIONS (PGOI) in professional fields ranging from Diploma to Post graduation imparting knowledge and skills to think ‘Beyond the Future’. In the span of 18 years PGOI has earned its name and fame not only in the country but also abroad; to expand higher education for socio-economic development of the Nation besides scientific and technological advancement. The University is mandated to provide higher education leading up-to Ph.D. in the disciplines of Science, Education, Humanities, Commerce, Management, Engineering, Medical, Paramedical, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Animal Sciences, Forestry, Law, Journalism, Mass Communication, Environment and many other branches. /bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3
result = json.load(open('tmp/mpu-verify/result.json'))
assert len(result['courses']) == 98
assert len({c['course_id'] for c in result['courses']}) == 98
assert result['record_status'] == result['verification_outcome'] == 'manual_review'
db = sqlite3.connect('file:assets/data/career_path.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
rows = {}
query = '''WITH RECURSIVE tree(id,slug,name,parent_id,breadcrumb) AS (
  SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,name FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id,c.slug,c.name,c.parent_id,tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name
  FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id=tree.id
) SELECT id,slug,breadcrumb FROM tree'''
for row in db.execute(query):
    rows[row[0]] = (row[1], row[2])
for course in result['courses']:
    for mapping in course['career_path_mappings']:
        assert (mapping['career_node_slug'], mapping['career_breadcrumb']) == rows[mapping['career_node_id']], course['name']
print('QA PASS', len(result['courses']), 'courses and', sum(len(c['career_path_mappings']) for c in result['courses']), 'validated mappings')
PY"
